content:
I upgraded to Apple Watch Series 12 last week, and after a few days of testing, there are three features that left the deepest impression on me.

#1: The S11 chip makes every operation faster

The Apple Watch should have switched to a new chip long ago — Apple made no updates at all last year, and there has been no real performance upgrade since the S9.

I can happily say that the new S11 chip is noticeably faster and more powerful than the previous S10.

Day-to-day operations on the Series 12 feel very snappy. And the headline Siri AI feature in watchOS 27 is clearly designed for this latest hardware. I've tested it, and Siri runs a bit sluggishly on older hardware, but on the Series 12 it comes close to the level I was hoping for.

#2: New health features and watch face complications

The new Health Sensing System should make the Series 12 more accurate at tracking key metrics like heart rate and steps. But this time, the improvements go beyond just accuracy.

Thanks to the new health sensors, the Series 12 offers three watch face complications that weren't available before:

  • Heart Rate
  • Daily Steps
  • Readiness

You can see real-time heart rate, steps, and readiness scores directly on the watch face.

I tried out the heart rate complication, but the readiness one needs a bit more data before it's usable. Overall, these features are quite welcome and meaningfully enhance the Apple Watch's health and wellness capabilities.

#3: Faster charging

The Series 12's battery life is roughly the same as the Series 11, but in outdoor workout mode it can last about 25% longer.

Longer battery life is certainly welcome, but I'm even more fond of the Series 12's fast charging. Here's how it compares with the Series 11:

  • Apple Watch Series 12: 15 minutes of charging gives up to 12 hours of battery life
  • Apple Watch Series 11: 15 minutes of charging gives up to 8 hours of battery life

I wear my Apple Watch to sleep and usually charge it up as quickly as possible at night, but sometimes I really don't leave it on the charger for long. With fast charging on the Series 12, my rather poor time-management habits are no longer an issue.

For a fuller review of the Series 12, check out my colleague Chance's complete review.

The Apple Watch Series 12 is now on sale, starting at US$399.

Have you upgraded to the Apple Watch Series 12? What's your reason? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
